import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartSeamCollapse
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Separated

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace ProbeP4R6k

theorem controlSorry : True := by sorry

/-- Does IsDominant follow from IrreducibleSpace + Nonempty for an OPEN inclusion?
If it is one lemma away, my docstring's "not an exotic side condition" hedge is
understated and I should apply it. -/
theorem probeDominantFromIrred {X : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace X] (V : X.Opens)
    (hne : (V : Set X).Nonempty) :
    IsDominant (V.ι) := by
  rw [isDominant_iff]
  simpa [DenseRange, Scheme.Opens.range_ι] using V.2.dense hne

end ProbeP4R6k

end AlgebraicGeometry
